title: Composite hard GPU-compute plus TPU-lite role (tunable GPU)

gpu_lanes.doc: Resident gpu-compute lanes. The measured one-lane build uses 24 MULT12X12 plus 3 MULTALU27X18 cells, equivalent to 15 of the GW5A-25A's 28 large DSP sites.

gpu_data_words.doc: Power-of-two resident GPU global-memory words. The fit probe uses the compact 256-word buffer.

layout_revision.doc: Composite source-selection marker and MMIO layout revision; revision 1 is the only defined value.
